question: The provisions for salaries and emoluments of constitutional authorities are mentioned in which Schedule?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Second Schedule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Second Schedule** of the Indian Constitution contains provisions related to the salaries, allowances, and privileges of constitutional authorities.
 
• It covers the President, Vice-President, Governors of states, Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha, Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha, and Judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts.
 
• Members of the State Legislature and Comptroller and Auditor-General of India (CAG) are also included under this schedule.
 
• The salaries and emoluments mentioned in the Second Schedule are subject to periodic revision by the Parliament of India.
 
• This schedule ensures financial independence for constitutional functionaries, reinforcing their autonomy and impartiality.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Schedules in the Indian Constitution:**

 
 
• The Indian Constitution initially had 8 schedules; currently, it has 12 schedules after subsequent amendments.
 
• Each schedule provides details about specific provisions that supplement the articles of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Second Schedule:**
 
 
• It safeguards the financial independence of constitutional authorities, enabling them to perform their duties without undue influence.
 
• The autonomy provided through financial provisions ensures the integrity of public administration and governance.
 
 
 
• **Examples of Other Schedules:**
 
 
• **Seventh Schedule:** Deals with the division of powers between the Union and States through Union, State, and Concurrent Lists.
 
• **Ninth Schedule:** Contains laws that are exempted from judicial review under certain conditions.
 
• **Third Schedule:** Prescribes the forms of oaths and affirmations for constitutional officeholders.
 
 
 
• **Amendments to the Second Schedule:**
 
 
• The provisions in the Second Schedule have been amended multiple times to revise the salaries and allowances of constitutional authorities.
 
• Such amendments ensure that the remuneration of officeholders reflects the changing economic conditions and responsibilities of their roles.
